statements.t: “We expect continued strong revenue conversion in the back half of the year, with revenue increasing sequentially through the rest of the year.”
“Our continued focus on working capital efficiency and disciplined capital allocation is translating into stronger cash generation and ongoing deleveraging going forward,” said Marco Portmann.

“Nonetheless, we are slightly updating our leverage guidance 3 , now expecting to end 2026 with a leverage of 2.0x or slightly above, reflecting temporary investments in securing our supply chain and protecting our margins.”
